verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile lets users chat with Copilot in natural language about public and private repositories and have it open a new pull request. Users can also start and track Copilot cloud agent tasks, assign issues to Copilot to get a ready-to-review PR, and refine that PR through comments. Edits and commits are implied by the agent producing PRs, but the evidence does not show conversational control over individual git operations. Missing for 10: explicit conversational commit/pull/push operations, agent-driven repo search via chat, and independent hands-on corroboration of the mobile agent workflow.
